title: Locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested sets (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2); Ch. 1, 3.6)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let A ⊆ B ⊆ U be Borel sets with H^n(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then for H^n-a.e. x ∈ A and every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P: B has approximate tangent space Q at x (Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4; HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q) if and only if A has approximate tangent space Q at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q
